$description: EIJA Studio design-system manifest in DTCG Format Module 2025.10 (Final Community Group Report, not a W3C Standard; opened 2026-09-29 at https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/). This file does four things: it lists the token files and who owns them; it fixes the CSS layering and naming contract the generator follows; it defines the density-mode tokens that components read; and it carries the component inventory and the size and load budgets as data so tests read one source. Every number is a DESIGN_TARGET (a hypothesis) unless its extension record says LITERATURE_LIMIT or DERIVED. Nothing here is a measurement of users. Decision record: docs/adr/0068-hci-design-system-architecture.md. Design document: docs/hci/design/design-system-architecture.md.

dtcg.status: Final Community Group Report of 28 October 2025, considered stable, not a W3C Standard
dtcg.pin: Do not follow /tr/drafts/. Files use the .tokens.json extension the specification lists.

pipeline.generator: scripts/build_tokens.py (proposed; Python standard library only; about 140 code lines, reference in docs/hci/design/design-system-architecture.md Appendix A)
pipeline.output-policy: Committed, never hand-edited. A test regenerates it and compares bytes (DS-01).
pipeline.fail-closed: Every token is validated before the emit filter, so an unsupported $type under a root that is not emitted (bundle, budget, load) is refused too. Unsupported $type, a dimension unit other than px or rem, a duration unit other than ms or s, an unsupported colour space, a hex that disagrees with its OKLCH source, a dangling alias, a cyclic alias, a duplicate token path and a root group listed in neither emit nor emit-not stop the build with an explicit error (DS-02: 15 negative fixtures).
supported-types: typography (composite: one custom property per member)
pipeline.not-supported-reason: The anti-slop rubric bans decorative gradients and shadow-only elevation; a token type that only serves them is refused until an HCI-ADR needs it.
pipeline.emit-not-reason: Budgets are read by tests, not by the browser; shipping them would add bytes for nothing. Every root group must be in emit or emit-not; a new group is classified here first.
pipeline.modes: Density (and any non-colour mode) uses $extensions.mode.<name> on the token (the shape Terrazzo 2.7.1 reads, verified 2026-09-29) and is written under [data-density="compact"]. The key mode is a tool-specific Terrazzo key, not a reverse-domain key as DTCG recommends for extensions; it is kept until a resolver document is tested with both tools.
pipeline.oracle: @terrazzo/cli 2.7.1 may cross-check the generator on a machine that has Node 22; it reports NOT_RUN without Node and is never a gate. MEASURED 2026-09-29 (re-run): with its lint rule core/valid-color switched off it builds 243 tokens; of 106 non-colour custom-property names present in both outputs, 104 have identical values and 2 (the font stacks) differ only in Terrazzo's quoting of every family; with the rule on it stops with 28 errors and 12 warnings on the colour aspect's oklch components whose hue is the DTCG value "none".
pipeline.color-output: The hex value, as the colour aspect asks (docs/hci/design/color-system.md section 10). OKLCH stays the source of truth; the build checks that every hex equals its OKLCH components within 1 unit per 8-bit channel (MEASURED 2026-09-29 on color.tokens.json: 102 of 102 objects agree, maximum deviation 0).
pipeline.theme-output: Colour tokens are sibling groups color.light.* and color.dark.*. Each pair becomes one role, --color-<path>, written three times as the colour aspect specifies (C9): :root for light, a prefers-color-scheme block for dark, and :root[data-theme="dark"]. Deviation from C9: color-scheme is written on :root[data-ui="next"] (and its data-theme variants) until phase S8, because a global color-scheme changed the unmodified legacy page under a dark OS (MEASURED 2026-09-29, M12). MEASURED on the five real files: 14,538 B of custom properties and color-scheme rules. The alternative light-dark() output measured 10,302 B against 14,386 B for the first version of the generator (28% smaller; not re-measured after later changes), passes the CSP (MEASURED), and is not used because the colour aspect declined to rely on a feature MDN lists as newly available since May 2024; Baseline calls it widely available 30 months later (about November 2026, https://web.dev/baseline), when the question goes back to the colour aspect.
pipeline.font-face: @font-face rules are generated from design/fonts.lock.json (type aspect): css_family, shipped.file, unicode_range, font_face_rules. They sit inside tokens.css, which the entry sheet imports with layer(tokens) (MEASURED 2026-09-29, M13: the font loads under the Studio's CSP plus font-src 'self'), and reference flat /assets names (interface I-SEC1). Long unicode-range values are wrapped after commas so that no line exceeds 100 characters.

css.layer-order-rule: Declared once, in the first line of the first stylesheet the page loads. Unlayered author CSS is refused because it outranks every layer (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@layer, opened 2026-09-29). The only rules allowed outside a layer are @layer statements and @import ... layer() in the entry sheet; every other file is reached through such an import. tokens.css has no @layer of its own. Test DS-03.
css.legacy-layer: The unmodified baseline app.css is imported as @import url(...) layer(legacy) so that new layers outrank it without specificity fights; tokens.css is imported as @import url(...) layer(tokens). It is deleted when empty (strangler plan, phase S8).

tiers.T1: Scale and palette tokens, one per value, named for position (--space-4, --color-neutral-9). Generated. Components must not read palette names.
tiers.T2: Role tokens that change with theme or density (--density-control-height, colour roles). Generated. Components read these.
tiers.T3: Component-private custom properties, prefixed --_ and declared in the component's own rule from T1 or T2 values. Hand-written, never in JSON, never part of an API.

css.tier-rule: A tier exists only where a value changes across it. Spacing has no T2 because nothing about a gap changes with theme or density; density-dependent sizes do.
css.naming: DTCG path with dots replaced by hyphens, prefixed by two dashes: space.4 becomes --space-4. No global prefix (no third-party CSS is loaded).

theme.mechanism: Root only in v1, as the colour aspect specifies. A nested theme region is not supported; it would need to re-apply background and text roles because color inherits as a computed value (MEASURED 2026-09-29, Chromium 151, with the light-dark() form). color-scheme is not inert for legacy CSS, so it is scoped (MEASURED 2026-09-29, M12: a global one changed 895 computed values and the screenshot of the legacy page under emulated dark).
theme.color-scheme: :root[data-ui="next"], with [data-theme="light"] and [data-theme="dark"] variants of that selector, until S8; then :root

density.mechanism: Custom properties inherit, so any region may be compact (MEASURED 2026-09-29, Chromium 151).

css.data-hooks-source: data-eija-source (values chrome, model, ai, provider, user), data-eija-state and data-eija-model are the hooks of docs/hci/research/ai-generated-ui-slop-and-first-impressions.md section 6 and HCI-ADR-0065 D7; data-eija-component is added here so the gallery can find every component instance.

files.holds: manifest, density role tokens, budgets, component inventory
palette and roles, sibling groups light and dark
files.state: present on 2026-09-29: 142 colour tokens (71 light, 71 dark), oklch with hex

files.holds: font families, weights, five sizes, line heights, nine text composites
files.state: present on 2026-09-29: 2 fontFamily, 2 fontWeight, 6 dimension, 7 number, 9 typography tokens

files.holds: font files, hashes, unicode ranges, @font-face parameters

interfaces-from-other-aspects.rule: The token files above are the interface: names are read from them, not repeated here. A component that reads a name the generator did not emit fails DS-04, so a renamed token cannot break a component silently. The lists below record what this aspect assumes about the other aspects and the kernel.
interfaces-from-other-aspects.color: Roles are color.<theme>.surface.{canvas,raised,overlay,sunken}, text.*, border.{subtle,control}, accent.*, focus.ring, selection.wash, status.<word>.{fg,tint} for pass, fail, unknown, stale, conflict, not-run, blocked, proposed and running, diff.*, category.* and canvas.*. Elevation is a surface step plus border.hairline; no shadow token exists.
interfaces-from-other-aspects.font: font.family.{sans,mono}, font.weight.{regular,strong}, font.size.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}, font.lineHeight.*, font.letterSpacing.none, font.measure.*, and nine text.* composites. Generated names are kebab-case (--font-line-height-sm).
server: I-SEC1: /assets serves flat URL names from a checked-in allowlist with an extension-to-MIME map (font/woff2 included); files may sit in subdirectories on disk
I-SEC2: font-src 'self' is required now that three font files exist (typography ADR-0060, MEASURED there)
I-SEC3: the CSP string is one exported constant that the gallery server and DS-11 import
kernel: I-KERN1: the implementation fingerprint (adapters/identity.py) hashes every file under resources/web, so any UI file change makes technical receipts STALE and the release fixture untrusted until the owner stamps; a kernel ADR may hash browser assets as their own dimension
interfaces-from-other-aspects.layout: Density numbers come from docs/hci/design/layout-model.md section 3.5. Two resizable seams follow the APG window splitter (layout D6).

components.rule: A primitive exists only if at least two top tasks use it (DS-15 reads this list). A recipe is a documented composition of primitives with layout classes and no colour, type or state CSS of its own. Adding, removing or splitting an entry needs an HCI-ADR. States are the gallery's named states, not every CSS pseudo-class. Every string a component renders carries data-eija-source.

primitives.element: details, or a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls inside a row
span with inline svg glyph and a word
primitives.pattern: text and shape, never colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
APG toolbar with count buttons, one tab stop; counts by state, never a percentage alone (docs/hci/design/accessibility.md 5.8)

primitives.element: dialog opened with showModal(); the palette is a combobox with a listbox inside it
primitives.pattern: native dialog (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/dialog, opened 2026-09-29); APG combobox for the palette (docs/hci/design/accessibility.md 5.5)

primitives.element: button with popovertarget and an element with the popover attribute
primitives.pattern: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API (Baseline 2025, newly available since January 2025); term definitions and status reasons (docs/hci/design/content-and-onboarding.md D5)

density.$description: Role tokens components read for sizes that change with density. The default value is the default-density token; $extensions.mode.compact is the compact one. Any region may set data-density="compact".

control-height.$description: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

row-height.$description: Height of tree, list and table rows.

icon-size.$description: Glyph box for status marks and action glyphs.

field-height.$description: Height of fields that take typed answers.

chip-height.$description: Height of non-interactive chips only (24 px default, 20 px compact). An interactive chip must not read this role: it reads size.chip.default (--size-chip-default, 24 px in both densities), because the compact value is below the 24 px floor. DS-04 fails an interactive component that reads --density-chip-height; DS-07 checks the rendered size.

gutter.$description: General pane gutter: 12 px default, 8 px compact (layout aspect: 12 to 16 / 8; the lower default end is used). Not used next to a seam: content beside a seam is inset space.3 (12 px) from the seam centre line in both densities, because the seam's SC 2.5.8 spacing exception needs a 24 px circle on its 8 px hit area to meet no other target (docs/hci/design/design-system-architecture.md section 5.4). The layout aspect may set space.4 as the default.

bundle.$description: Size budgets for the shipped browser client, in bytes of source as served (the client is not minified: ADR-013 keeps it small and inspectable, and no build step exists). Derivation and limits: docs/hci/design/design-system-architecture.md section 6. All are DESIGN_TARGET hypotheses. The baseline (src/eija_studio/resources/web, MEASURED with wc -c on 2026-09-29) is app.js 10561, app.css 7156, index.html 7561. A budget breach fails DS-13 until an HCI-ADR states the new number. Values are unit-less DTCG numbers; the unit of each is in its extension record (B, characters, requests, levels).

js-total.$description: Bytes of JavaScript loaded on first render, all modules together, including the canvas module (25 000 to 45 000 ESTIMATED by the canvas aspect, no source).

css-total.$description: Bytes of CSS loaded on first render, including tokens.css and the legacy layer while it exists.

tokens-css.$description: Bytes of the generated tokens.css including @font-face rules. MEASURED 2026-09-29 on the five real token files and design/fonts.lock.json: 16,087 B (14,538 B of custom properties and color-scheme rules with the colour aspect's three-block theme output, 1,549 B of @font-face; 15,974 B before long lines were wrapped). The budget leaves about 12% headroom over the measured size.

file-max.$description: Bytes of any one shipped JS or CSS file. Keeps a file reviewable as a single unit; not derived from a measurement.

line-max.$description: Characters per line in shipped JS, CSS and HTML. The baseline has lines of 1585 (app.js), 7155 (app.css) and 1446 (index.html) characters (MEASURED), which makes a line diff unreadable for reviewers and for agents. Generated files are included: the generator wraps long values after commas (the first version wrote 5 lines of 118 to 473 characters).

requests-first-render.$description: Requests for the page, its stylesheets, scripts and fonts before the first API call. Derived: about 15 JS files (120,000 B at about 8,000 B each), 6 CSS files, 1 HTML file, 3 fonts is 25, plus 20% margin. Each request is about 2.2 ms p50 on loopback (MEASURED); the limit protects the size of the allowlist, and time is governed by module depth.

module-depth.$description: Longest chain of static imports. Each level is one sequential request wave.

font-total.$description: Bytes of WOFF2 loaded for the first paint. The type aspect ships 40,904 B in 3 files (design/fonts.lock.json, MEASURED there) against its ceiling of 100,000 B, which is the figure proposed in docs/hci/research/visual-design-foundations.md section 4 item 5.

load.$description: Cold-load budget: navigation start until the connection chip shows the provider (the baseline's ready signal). Same 1 s limit and 200 ms target as the view class in motion.tokens.json (budget.view). Baseline MEASURED 2026-09-29: p50 114.3 ms, p95 159.1 ms, n = 22, Chromium 151 headless, Windows 11, other agents running.

ready-target.$description: p95 over at least 30 cold loads; exceeding it is a warning.

ready-limit.$description: 1 s keeps the flow of thought (https://www.nngroup.com/articles/response-times-3-important-limits/, opened 2026-09-29); exceeding it fails.
